description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Murderous Rider, adding {C}{C}.
Murderous Rider dies, putting itself from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Murderous Rider into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, then putting Murderous Rider from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat.
